description:
Create a digital logic circuit diagram for a 4-bit Ripple Carry Adder using draw.io.

The circuit specification is provided in the file '~/Desktop/adder_specification.txt'.

Your task has two parts, to be created on two separate pages in the same file:

1. PAGE 1: '4-Bit Ripple Carry Adder' (Block Level)
   - Create 4 Full Adder blocks labeled FA0, FA1, FA2, FA3.
   - Connect them in a ripple carry chain: Cout of FA0 -> Cin of FA1, etc.
   - Label all inputs: A0-A3, B0-B3.
   - Label all outputs: S0-S3, Cout (or C4).
   - Ground the first carry input (Cin=0).

2. PAGE 2: 'Full Adder Gate Level' (Schematic)
   - Draw the internal logic of a single Full Adder using logic gates (XOR, AND, OR).
   - Implement the equations:
     Sum = A XOR B XOR Cin
     Cout = (A AND B) OR (Cin AND (A XOR B))
   - Label inputs (A, B, Cin) and outputs (Sum, Cout).
   - Add the Boolean equations as text annotations.

3. SAVE AND EXPORT:
   - Save the diagram as '~/Desktop/ripple_carry_adder.drawio'.
   - Export Page 1 as '~/Desktop/ripple_carry_adder.png'.

You will need to enable the 'Electrical / Logic Gates' shape library (or use standard shapes labeled clearly).
